text:
sam: Late-night entertainment poll! staying up, need either 1 album to zone out to or 1 movie to put on. Quick votes: :headphones: = album, :film_projector: = movie. Drop recs or just react. @here

anya: :headphones: — 'Moon Safari' by Air. perfect chill, esp at 2am. here's a curated playlist i threw together: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2mj-example (low-key, no vocals on a few)

ben: :film_projector: — if you want moody + stylish, watch 'Manhunter' (1986). slow burn, great synth score. popcorn optional.

mika: album rec: 'In Rainbows' (Radiohead) for late-night introspection. also, if anyone wants a book instead, try 'Never Let Me Go' — haunting and quiet.

sam: adding a wildcard: for movie + music combo, try 'Drive' — soundtrack slaps. :motor_scooter:

anya: LOL that soundtrack is criminally good. :heart_eyes:

joel: voted :headphones: (Moon Safari). also adding a tiny playlist snippet:```Spotify - Moon Safari vibes
1. Sexy Boy — Air
2. La femme d'argent — Air
3. All I Need — Radiohead```

ben: @mika totally on 'Never Let Me Go' — read it on a plane last year, couldn't stop thinking about it.

mika: quick poll idea: if we all pick one, should we make a shared late-night playlist in #random? simple collaborative doc. thumbs up if yes. :+1:

sam: :+1: do it. i'll create and drop link.

anya: :+1: and maybe a pinned message with movie recs for future nights.

joel: created the playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0example-latenight. added Moon Safari, Drive OST, In Rainbows. feel free to add.

ben: perfect. i'm off to put Manhunter on. night folks.

mika: night! thanks for the recs.

sam: thread summary: album — Moon Safari / In Rainbows; movie — Manhunter / Drive. shared playlist + pinned recs. good vibes. :crescent_moon:
